title: Where Did the Pomo Tribe Live in California? - ScienceInsights
text: The Pomo were not a single unified tribe but seven distinct groups, each speaking its own language within the Pomoan language family. Scholars typically identify them by direction: Southwestern, Southern, Central, Northern, Northeastern, Eastern, and Southeastern Pomo.
